caption: The drawing depicts a wooden hand tool, specifically a molding plane, used in woodworking. The object is predominantly beige or light yellow in color, with details of wood grain visible throughout. The tool features two cylindrical rods that extend horizontally through the main body, capped at their ends with brownish-gold colored tips. There is a rectangular main block with an angled blade protruding from the bottom and a brass screw or knob on top for adjustment. The side of the plane has intricately shaped guides and stops, which are also beige in color. Shadows and highlights are used to show the three-dimensional form and the smooth surface of the tool. The drawing is contained within a red rectangular border, with the identifier "DEL. 156-1" and the name "James M. Lawson" written in the lower right corner. The background is an off-white or cream color, with no other objects present.
title: Ivory Carpenter's Plane
